notes:
Summary: Mid-size legal tech vendor focused on contract and regulatory discovery for law firms and corporate legal teams. Wants a private/VPC deployment with strict retention and audit logging. Primary ask: embeddings + reranking pipeline that can index tens of millions of pages, provide sub-second perceived latency for end users, and keep per-query cost predictable for enterprise pricing.

Recent activity:
- 2025-01-15: Intro call (AE Maya) — buyer (CTO: Rajiv Menon), Head LegalTech Product (Sara Molina). High-level product fit confirmed: RAG for contract search and multi-jurisdiction discovery.
- 2025-01-20: Technical kickoff with SE (Liam) — discussed architecture: two-stage retrieval (ANN embeddings -> cross-encoder reranker). Customer demoed internal prototype built on open-source vectors + an in-house BERT-based reranker.
- 2025-01-28: POC scope agreed: 2M doc subset (contracts + court filings), evaluation metrics (MRR, NDCG@10), latency SLOs (p99 end-to-end < 700ms for UI; dedicated reranker step < 300ms), cost target <$0.015/query average at scale.
- 2025-02-04: Security questionnaire delivered (Drive link). Customer requires BYOK (KMS) + audit logging forwarded to their SIEM, 7-year retention for audit trails.
- 2025-02-10: POC ingest started (ETL connector to SharePoint + Box), initial indexing progress ~12% (approx 240k docs).

Technical/requirements notes and constraints:
- Scale: eventual target 30-50M pages (documents chunked into 2-4k tokens). Need incremental indexing and efficient re-index for redactions.
- Retrieval: dense embeddings with approximate nearest neighbor for candidate generation. Candidate set size expected 100-200 for reranker.
- Reranking: cross-encoder on private infra preferred (sensitive content). Model preference: open, smaller cross-encoders or quantized LLM reranker; team open to Redwood's curated models if hosted privately.
- Latency: interactive legal UI requires perceived response <1s. Allow batching for background analytics but UI path must be low-latency.
- Cost sensitivity: CFO requires modeled spend at 10M queries/month; target blended cost < $0.015/query (embeddings + rerank), wants Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching/quantization.
- Security/compliance: mandatory SSO/SAML, SOC2 report, ISO27001 preferred, customer-managed KMS for key separation, detailed audit logs with immutable export for eDiscovery. Data residency: US primary but some EU clients require EU-only storage for subsets.
- Integration: connectors for SharePoint, Box, internal DMS; must support document-level retention tags and redaction metadata.

POC success criteria (agreed):
- NDCG@10 improvement over baseline by >=12% on seeded legal queries.
- End-to-end median latency <350ms, p99 <700ms on test cluster sized to match target QPS.
- Cost model validated with Redwood's tooling; per-query estimates within 10% of modeled.
- Security checklist items completed (SOC2 + KMS integration in staging).

Quotes / call snippets:
- "We can't accept any provider that can't give us BYOK and a clean audit trail." — Rajiv (CTO).
- "If you can bring cost predictability at 10M queries, procurement will move fast." — Head of Ops.

Open technical questions for SE/Infra:
- Does Redwood support incremental vector updates without full re-index? Desired: live document add/update latency < 5 minutes.
- Can reranker run inside customer VPC/private deploy with GPU-backed Dedicated nodes? Need kernel hints for quantized cross-encoders.
- Audit logging: need log format spec and retention export mechanism (S3 push) for eDiscovery.

Next steps (near-term):

- Customer security team to return completed questionnaire (expected 2025-02-20).
- Arrange access for Redwood engineers to test KMS integration in sandbox (tentative week of 2025-02-17).
